process.discoveryMethod: Searched full 23,363-line TXT for standalone 'ground vehicle', 'air vehicle', 'water vehicle', specific speeder/airspeeder/walker type lines, and other vehicle-like CL-statblocks. Found six civilian vehicles pp92–95 plus Basilisk war droid printed p203 in Mandalorian droid section.
process.primaryPdf: Verified the seven complete published statblocks directly in supplied scanned PDF by rendering physical pp93–96 and p204; source SHA-256 matches historical PDF ledger. Reused prior PDF-provenance reviews of all 32 ships.
process.physicalPdfPageRule: For new claims, 1-based physical PDF page = printed page + 1. Inherited pages copy historical verified physical-page fields, not inferred.
process.initialSourceScope: 32 previously reviewed spacecraft; do not implicitly promote 7 new vehicle records into existing compendium pack
process.exhaustivenessCaveat: Full-text search and focused rendered source pages locate known standalone vehicle statblocks; text recognition can omit graphic-only text elsewhere, so no unsupported claim every scanned PDF page was independently visually checked.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Basilisk War Droid
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Published under Mandalorian droids but printed type is 'Huge air vehicle (droid)' and statblock includes both atmospheric and starship-scale flight. Single vehicle-droid publication identity, not an ordinary Droid Actor duplicating the entry.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Aratech Urban Navigator Speeder Bike
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Section says speeder bike, but printed statblock explicitly 'Large air vehicle (speeder)' with fly movement; keep primary air-speeder-bike classification and printed type.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Lhosan Industries Swoop Racer
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Separate full CL 2 speeder statblock; do not split racing and civilian narrative descriptions into variants.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: SoroSuub Twin-228 cargo pod
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Equipment/cargo-pod configuration of one printed Twin-228 statblock; do not enumerate separately.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Duwani Juggernaut War Droid, Czerka Mark I Assault Droid and other combat droids
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Independent droid creature/NPC statblocks are not printed vehicle statblocks. Basilisk is the explicit exception supported by its vehicle type line.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Star Forge orbital factory
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Orbital structure and encounter setting without a separate complete vehicle-statblock identity in this source census.
